```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Load the package from the checkout with pkgload; no package install is
# required. Under altdoc the render runs in a temp dir, so resolve the root
# first (CFB2NFL_ROOT in the site build, else walk up to the _targets store).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT", "")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  dir <- getwd()
  while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets")) && dirname(dir) != dir) {
    dir <- dirname(dir)
  }
  root <- if (file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets"))) dir else getwd()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(duckdb)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

# One interaction style for every girafe figure: a clear hover pop, dimming
# of non-hovered marks, a dark tooltip, and toolbar zoom + PNG download.
set_girafe_defaults(
  opts_hover = opts_hover(
    css = "stroke:#111827;stroke-width:2.5px;filter:brightness(1.12);"
  ),
  opts_hover_inv = opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.45;"),
  opts_tooltip = opts_tooltip(
    css = "background:#111827;color:#fff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;"
  ),
  opts_zoom = opts_zoom(min = 1, max = 5),
  opts_toolbar = opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE, position = "topright"),
  opts_sizing = opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
)

# thousands-separated and percent formatters for inline numbers
fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  formatC(as.numeric(x), big.mark = ",", format = "f", digits = digits)
}
pct <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf("%.*f%%", digits, 100 * x)
```

```{r}
#| label: registry
#| include: false
# Key on athlete id, never name (recruiting ids collide, decision 0013).
subjects <- tibble::tribble(
  ~who            , ~cfb_athlete_id ,
  "Joe Burrow"    , "3915511"       ,
  "Cam Ward"      , "4688380"       ,
  "Jordan Travis" , "4360799"       ,
  "Shane Buechele" , "4039034"      ,
  "Kyle Allen"    , "559681"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: load
#| include: false
# Season arcs and game production are derived pipeline tables (decision 0037),
# bundled in the DuckDB, so the post reads exactly what the tests cover.
sa <- dbReadTable(con, "season_arc")
gp <- dbReadTable(con, "game_production")
pg <- dbReadTable(con, "player_game")
stopifnot(nrow(sa) > 0, nrow(gp) > 0, nrow(pg) > 0)

band_levels <- c(
  "Under 1400",
  "1400 to 1599",
  "1600 to 1799",
  "1800 and up",
  "Unrated"
)
pass_games <- gp |>
  filter(.data$stat == "pass_yds") |>
  mutate(opponent_elo_band = factor(.data$opponent_elo_band, band_levels))
cast_qb <- sa |>
  filter(.data$category == "passing") |>
  inner_join(subjects, by = c(playerId = "cfb_athlete_id"))
```

```{r}
#| label: facts
#| include: false
# Every figure in the post is computed here and pinned.
ward <- cast_qb |> filter(.data$who == "Cam Ward") |> arrange(.data$season)
ward_yds <- ward$value
stopifnot(
  identical(ward$season, 2021:2024),
  identical(as.numeric(ward_yds), c(376, 3218, 3732, 4313))
)

# Which cast members' passing arcs rise every season they are in the data.
rises_every_season <- cast_qb |>
  arrange(.data$who, .data$season) |>
  group_by(.data$who) |>
  summarise(rises = all(diff(.data$value) > 0), .groups = "drop")
stopifnot(
  sum(rises_every_season$rises) == 1L,
  rises_every_season$rises[rises_every_season$who == "Cam Ward"]
)

# Raw yardage by opponent band: a mild decline with opponent strength.
band_yds <- pass_games |>
  group_by(.data$opponent_elo_band) |>
  summarise(
    games = dplyr::n(),
    mean_yds = mean(.data$value),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(.data$opponent_elo_band)
stopifnot(
  all(diff(band_yds$mean_yds[1:4]) < 0),
  round(band_yds$mean_yds[1] - band_yds$mean_yds[4]) == 16
)
unrated_share <- mean(pass_games$opponent_elo_band == "Unrated")
stopifnot(round(unrated_share, 3) == 0.272)

# Opponent-adjusted residual by season for the cast, from the baseline.
cast_res <- gp |>
  filter(.data$stat == "pass_yds") |>
  inner_join(subjects, by = c(playerId = "cfb_athlete_id")) |>
  group_by(.data$who, .data$season) |>
  summarise(
    games = dplyr::n(),
    mean_resid = mean(.data$residual),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
stopifnot(
  all(cast_res$mean_resid[cast_res$who == "Cam Ward"] > 0),
  sum(cast_res$mean_resid[cast_res$who == "Jordan Travis"] < 0) == 2L
)

# Share of all player-games with no opponent Elo (the unrated band).
opp_na <- mean(is.na(pg$opponent_pregame_elo))
stopifnot(round(opp_na, 3) == 0.267)
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
*Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-11-05. Careers of recent
classes are right-censored; later seasons may not yet be present.*
:::

## 1. Introduction

A quarterback's yardage moves from season to season and game to game, and
opponent strength is one reason. This post follows the passing yards of five
recent college quarterbacks and asks whether each season beat the league
baseline for opponents of the same strength.

+ *Expectation one: Cam Ward's passing yards rose in every season in the data.*
+ *Expectation two: passing yardage falls modestly as opponent Elo rises.*
+ *Expectation three: Cam Ward's yardage beat the opponent-adjusted baseline each season, while Jordan Travis's fell below it in two.*

## 2. Data

### 2.1 Each game is set against the league baseline for its opponent strength

Each player-game is compared with the average for the same season and opponent band.

```{r}
#| label: terms
tibble::tribble(
  ~Term                     , ~Meaning                                          ,
  "Season arc"              , "Season total of passing yards, one per season.",
  "Season index"            , "The player's n-th season with a stat line in the data.",
  "Opponent band"           , "The opponent's pregame Elo: under 1400, 1400 to 1599, 1600 to 1799, 1800 and up, or unrated (no Elo).",
  "Baseline"                , "Mean yards for that season, band, and stat across all passers.",
  "Residual"                , "A game's yards minus its baseline."
) |>
  kable(caption = "The terms used in the post.")
```

## 3. Results

### 3.1 Cam Ward's passing yards rose in every season in the data

*Expectation: his yardage rose in each season, and no other cast member's did.* ✅

Only Ward's arc climbs at every step among the five cast members.

```{r}
#| label: s31-table
cast_qb |>
  arrange(.data$who, .data$season) |>
  transmute(
    Player = .data$who,
    Season = .data$season,
    `Season index` = .data$season_index,
    Team = .data$team,
    `Passing yards` = fmt(.data$value)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Season passing yards for the five cast quarterbacks.")
```

```{r}
#| label: s31-explain
#| fig-height: 6
p <- cast_qb |>
  ggplot(aes(.data$season_index, .data$value, colour = .data$who)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = paste0(.data$who, ", ", .data$season, ": ", fmt(.data$value), " yards"))
  ) +
  labs(x = "Season index", y = "Passing yards", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: s31-explore
#| fig-height: 6
p <- cast_qb |>
  mutate(label = paste0(.data$who, " (", .data$season, ")")) |>
  ggplot(aes(.data$season, .data$value, colour = .data$who)) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = paste0(.data$who, ", ", .data$season, ": ", fmt(.data$value), " yards")),
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(x = "Season", y = "Passing yards", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

### 3.2 Passing yardage falls modestly as opponent Elo rises

*Expectation: raw yardage decreases from the weakest to the strongest rated band.* ✅

Raw yards drop by about 16 a game from the weakest rated band to the strongest,
and unrated opponents sit near the bottom.

```{r}
#| label: s32-table
band_yds |>
  transmute(
    `Opponent band` = .data$opponent_elo_band,
    `Passer games` = fmt(.data$games),
    `Mean passing yards` = fmt(.data$mean_yds, 1)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Mean passing yards per game by opponent band, all passers.")
```

```{r}
#| label: s32-explain
#| fig-height: 6
p <- band_yds |>
  mutate(
    opponent_elo_band = factor(.data$opponent_elo_band, band_levels),
    tooltip = paste0(.data$opponent_elo_band, ": ", fmt(.data$mean_yds, 1), " yards")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(.data$opponent_elo_band, .data$mean_yds, fill = .data$opponent_elo_band == "Unrated")) +
  geom_col_interactive(aes(tooltip = .data$tooltip), show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "#4C78A8", `TRUE` = "#9CA3AF")) +
  labs(x = "Opponent band", y = "Mean passing yards per game") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: s32-explore
#| fig-height: 6
p <- pass_games |>
  group_by(.data$season, .data$opponent_elo_band) |>
  summarise(mean_yds = mean(.data$value), games = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(.data$season, .data$mean_yds, colour = .data$opponent_elo_band)) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = paste0(.data$season, ", ", .data$opponent_elo_band, ": ", fmt(.data$mean_yds, 1), " yards over ", fmt(.data$games), " games")),
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(x = "Season", y = "Mean passing yards per game", colour = "Opponent band") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

### 3.3 Cam Ward beat the opponent-adjusted baseline each season, and Jordan Travis fell below it twice

*Expectation: Ward's residuals are positive in every season, and Travis's are negative in two.* ✅

The residual averages a player's gains over the baseline season by season.

```{r}
#| label: s33-table
cast_res |>
  arrange(.data$who, .data$season) |>
  transmute(
    Player = .data$who,
    Season = .data$season,
    Games = .data$games,
    `Mean residual (yards)` = fmt(.data$mean_resid, 1)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Mean passing-yard residual per game, by cast player and season.")
```

```{r}
#| label: s33-explain
#| fig-height: 6
p <- cast_res |>
  mutate(
    tooltip = paste0(.data$who, ", ", .data$season, ": ", fmt(.data$mean_resid, 1), " yards over baseline")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(.data$season, .data$mean_resid, fill = .data$who)) +
  geom_col_interactive(aes(tooltip = .data$tooltip), position = "dodge") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  labs(x = "Season", y = "Mean residual (yards per game)", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: s33-explore
#| fig-height: 6
p <- gp |>
  filter(.data$stat == "pass_yds") |>
  inner_join(subjects, by = c(playerId = "cfb_athlete_id")) |>
  ggplot(aes(.data$season, .data$residual, colour = .data$who)) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = paste0(.data$who, ", ", .data$season, ", week ", .data$week, " vs ", .data$opponent, ": ", fmt(.data$residual), " yards")),
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  labs(x = "Season", y = "Residual (yards in the game)", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

## 4. Summary

Cam Ward's arc is the only one among the five that rose at every step, and his
yardage stayed above baseline in each season.

```{r}
#| label: summary
tibble::tribble(
  ~Expectation                                           , ~Verdict , ~Evidence                              ,
  "Ward's passing yards rose in every season"            , "✅"     , "376, 3,218, 3,732, 4,313 yards (2021 to 2024)" ,
  "Passing yardage falls modestly as opponent Elo rises" , "✅"     , "About 16 yards per game, weakest to strongest rated band" ,
  "Ward above baseline each season; Travis below in two" , "✅"     , "Ward positive in all four seasons; Travis negative in 2020 and 2021"
) |>
  kable(caption = "Each expectation and what the data showed.")
```

## 5. Discussion

::: {.callout-important}
Ward's residuals stayed positive, so his yardage beat the baseline for opponents of the same strength in every season. The baseline compares every passer, so it cannot separate a quarterback's own play from the offense around him.
:::

Caveats: unrated opponents (no Elo, mostly lower-division teams) are kept as their own band rather than dropped; about 27% of player-games fall there. The data begin in 2010, so a career's first season in the data is not necessarily its first season in college. Five players is a snapshot, not a sample.
